meta.title: Rica Bouso — Communications strategist
meta.description: Rica Bouso, communications strategist. Director of Marketing at the Chicago Public Library Foundation. 15 years across nonprofit, agency, and corporate work in Asia and the US.

hero.title: Communications strategist building brands rooted in mission.
hero.metaLine2: Currently Director of Marketing at the Chicago Public Library Foundation.

about.paragraph1: For 15 years I have translated organizational purpose into measurable growth: at one of the largest library systems in the country, at a global business services company supporting 15,000 employees, and at agencies serving multi-industry clients.
about.paragraph2: Build the system, ground it in mission, and the metrics follow. I work the full stack of integrated marketing communications: brand strategy, audience development, content systems, digital marketing, PR, crisis response, and stakeholder management.
about.paragraph3: I am equally comfortable in the strategy room and the content calendar. Big ideas matter; so does the email that ships on Tuesday.

work.title: Live from the Library
work.desc: Led marketing for a flagship cultural program that reached 22M+ viewers and generated 800M PR impressions across 37 countries.

work.title: Donor Journey Campaign
work.desc: Designed and shipped an end-to-end nurture pipeline that converted general audiences into 200+ high-quality leads.

work.title: Brand System Rebuild
work.desc: Authored the brand voice and guide adopted across internal and external channels. Doubled site traffic. Lifted social engagement 117%. Pushed email open rates to 39%.

work.title: Live From Crisis: COVID-19 Communications
work.desc: Led crisis communications across 81 library branches during the pandemic, holding brand coherence while the operating reality shifted weekly.

work.title: Employer Brand Reset
work.desc: Built employee and recruitment branding initiatives that improved retention by 15% and lifted internal engagement by 25%.

work.title: Client Growth Engine
work.desc: Directed multi-client communication campaigns that lifted client site traffic from 50% to 70%.
